name: When should I call a professional plumber for a clogged toilet instead of trying DIY methods?

mainEntity.name: When should I call a professional plumber for a clogged toilet instead of trying DIY methods?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should call a professional plumber if a plunger doesn't clear the clog after a few attempts, if water starts backing up into other drains (like the shower or sink), or if you experience frequent or recurring clogs. These symptoms often indicate a more significant blockage deeper in your plumbing system or a sewer line issue. Attempting aggressive DIY methods with harsh chemicals can sometimes damage pipes, making the problem worse or more costly to repair. CG Plumbing Solutions has specialized tools like augers and hydro-jetting equipment to safely and effectively clear stubborn clogs without harming your plumbing.
acceptedAnswer.description: Call a professional plumber for a clogged toilet if plunging fails, water backs up elsewhere, or clogs are frequent, as these indicate deeper issues.
